Utilizing the Krylov spread complexity and entanglement entropy, we analyze two dynamical protocols: (i) preparing the non-Hermitian ground state via a unitary transformation, and (ii) evolving the system under the non-Hermitian Hamiltonian. We show that the spread complexity, and long-time spread complexity as well as entanglement entropy can effectively signal phase transitions in the first and second protocols, respectively. To unravel the detailed structure of the transitions, we introduce the momentum-resolved complexity that identifies the characteristic modes and tracks their evolution with the driving parameter. In the regime where the system possesses a purely imaginary spectrum, we further identify dynamical phases based on the saturation behavior of the spread complexity. The entanglement entropy is also found to exhibit similar saturation behavior, thereby providing a more experimentally accessible probe of the dynamical phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“利用Krylov spread complexity和纠缠熵进行分析”，并引入“动量分辨复杂度”等理论工具，未涉及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：非厄米扩展Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型，包含次近邻跳跃和虚交错化学势，研究其相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非厄米性较弱时，厄米极限的拓扑相边界附近会出现成对的例外点；Krylov spread复杂度和纠缠熵可有效标记相变，而新引入的动量分辨复杂度能揭示相变的详细结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非厄米性较弱时，厄米极限的拓扑相边界附近会出现成对的例外点；Krylov spread复杂度和纠缠熵可有效标记相变，而新引入的动量分辨复杂度能揭示相变的详细结构。；创新点：首次将动量分辨复杂度引入非厄米SSH模型，用于解析相变的详细结构；在系统具有纯虚能谱的区域，基于spread复杂度的饱和行为识别出动力学相，并发现纠缠熵具有类似的饱和行为，提供了更实验可及的探测手段。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：利用Krylov spread复杂度和纠缠熵，通过两种动力学协议（1. 通过幺正变换制备非厄米基态；2. 在非厄米哈密顿量下演化系统）研究相变；引入动量分辨复杂度识别特征模式并追踪其随驱动参数的变化。

papers.title: Speed limits on biomolecular processes from fundamental physical constants
papers.abstract: Many of the timescales of life have speed limits set by quantum-mechanical constraints along with non-fundamental quantities, such as the temperature of the environment, which are however bounded by anthropic considerations. Here, some of such speed limits are examined, including those for the rates of elementary chemical reactions and biomolecular folding. Limitations of simple back-of-envelope estimates are also discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要讨论的是“量子力学约束”和“基本物理常数”对生物分子过程速率极限的设定，属于理论分析范畴，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：生物分子过程，包括基本化学反应速率和生物分子折叠（如蛋白质折叠）的速率极限。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 生物分子过程中的许多时间尺度存在由量子力学约束和基本物理常数（如普朗克常数、精细结构常数等）设定的速度上限；环境温度等非基本量虽也影响速率，但其范围受人类存在条件（人择原理）的限制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：生物分子过程中的许多时间尺度存在由量子力学约束和基本物理常数（如普朗克常数、精细结构常数等）设定的速度上限；环境温度等非基本量虽也影响速率，但其范围受人类存在条件（人择原理）的限制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于基本物理常数和量子力学约束进行理论估算（back-of-envelope estimates），并讨论了这类简单估算的局限性。

papers.title: Where Does Surface $χ^{(2)}$ Come From? A Systematic Derivation of Nonlinear Surface Susceptibilities from Bulk Nonlocal Response
papers.abstract: We extend the distributional framework developed in the companion paper [Zolla, arXiv:2605.15716] to the nonlinear case, focusing on the second-order ($χ^{(2)}$) response responsible for second-harmonic generation (SHG). Starting from the most general tensorial nonlocal second-order constitutive relation and combining a spatial moment expansion with a distributional thin-layer limit, we show that the full complexity of the nonlinear interfacial response condenses, at leading order, into two scalars, the nonlinear surface susceptibilities $χ^{(2),s}_\parallel$ and $χ^{(2),s}_\perp$, associated with the tangential and normal components of the electric field, respectively. A key structural result is established: via a marginal integration over one field argument, the nonlinear surface problem reduces recursively to an effective linear one, whose surface susceptibility is determined by the bulk nonlinear kernel alone. Generalized nonlinear Maxwell boundary conditions are derived explicitly for planar and spherical interfaces, and curvature corrections are obtained systematically. The formalism is illustrated on Gaussian, Yukawa, and tensorial Lorentz kernels.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：distributional framework、spatial moment expansion、distributional thin-layer limit、generalized nonlinear Maxwell boundary conditions。；研究对象：非线性表面二阶非线性光学响应（χ⁽²⁾），特别是二次谐波产生（SHG）中表面非线性磁化率的来源与推导。体系包括平面和球形界面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从最一般的非局域二阶本构关系出发，通过空间矩展开和分布薄层极限，证明非线性界面响应的全部复杂性在主导阶可简化为两个标量：与电场切向分量和法向分量相关的表面非线性磁化率 χ⁽²⁾,s∥ 和 χ⁽²⁾,s⊥。非线性表面问题可通过对一个场参数进行边缘积分，递归地约化为一个有效线性问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从最一般的非局域二阶本构关系出发，通过空间矩展开和分布薄层极限，证明非线性界面响应的全部复杂性在主导阶可简化为两个标量：与电场切向分量和法向分量相关的表面非线性磁化率 χ⁽²⁾,s∥ 和 χ⁽²⁾,s⊥。非线性表面问题可通过对一个场参数进行边缘积分，递归地约化为一个有效线性问题。；创新点：建立了非线性表面问题到有效线性问题的递归约化结构，并系统推导了曲率修正。摘要未突出说明与以往唯象模型或数值方法的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用分布理论框架（扩展自同系列论文 Zolla, arXiv:2605.15716），结合空间矩展开（spatial moment expansion）和分布薄层极限（distributional thin-layer limit），对非局域二阶本构关系进行系统推导，并显式推导了平面和球形界面的广义非线性麦克斯韦边界条件，以及曲率修正项。示例计算使用了高斯、Yukawa 和张量洛伦兹核。

papers.title: Controlling many-body quantum chaos in a dissipative optical cavity
papers.abstract: Cavity quantum electrodynamics (QED) with ultracold fermions provides a promising platform for realizing many-body quantum chaos through disordered, photon-mediated long-range interactions. Such setups are inherently open and are therefore subject to dissipation arising from cavity photon loss and atomic spontaneous emission. In this article, we study the driven-dissipative dynamics of a typical cavity QED setting including controllable disorder and long-range interactions. We find that the two dissipation sources have qualitatively different structures. Cavity loss reduces to a single dephasing channel, whereas spontaneous emission in the experimentally relevant regime generates a collection of nonlocal dephasing channels. Cavity-induced dephasing preserves signatures distinguishing integrable from chaotic Hamiltonian dynamics in observables that depend linearly on the density matrix, while spontaneous emission suppresses these signatures. By contrast, quantities that probe the structure of the many-body state, such as the entanglement entropy, are strongly affected by both dissipation mechanisms. Assuming experimentally realistic parameters, we derive quantitative constraints for the observation and control of many-body quantum chaos in cavity-QED platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：study, find, derive constraints，无实验或计算细节描述）；研究对象：耗散光学腔中通过无序、光子介导长程相互作用实现的多体量子混沌系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 腔光子损耗和原子自发辐射两种耗散源具有不同结构：腔损耗仅产生单一退相干通道，而自发辐射产生非局域退相干通道集合；腔诱导退相干可保留可积与混沌哈密顿动力学的可观测特征，而自发辐射会抑制这些特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：腔光子损耗和原子自发辐射两种耗散源具有不同结构：腔损耗仅产生单一退相干通道，而自发辐射产生非局域退相干通道集合；腔诱导退相干可保留可积与混沌哈密顿动力学的可观测特征，而自发辐射会抑制这些特征。；创新点：揭示了两种耗散机制（腔损耗与自发辐射）对多体量子混沌可观测量的不同影响结构，并给出了在腔QED平台中观测和控制多体量子混沌的定量条件。
papers.method_zh: 采用驱动-耗散动力学理论框架，分析典型腔量子电动力学（cavity QED）设置，包含可控无序和长程相互作用，并基于实验现实参数推导定量约束条件。

papers.title: Theory of Spinful Relativistic Superfluids
papers.abstract: We construct an effective field theory description of relativistic superfluids with nonzero angular momentum density. At first order in the derivative expansion, the effective action contains a term with a quantized coefficient, which encodes the Berry phase for the angular momentum of the superfluid condensate. From this single term we derive a number of physical effects, including the relativistic Mermin-Ho relation, an anomalous Ettingshausen effect (exchangeable for an anomalous Hall effect), and an anomalous Hall viscosity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“构建有效场论描述”（construct an effective field theory description），属于理论框架构建。；研究对象：具有非零角动量密度的相对论性超流体（relativistic superfluids with nonzero angular momentum density），即自旋相对论超流体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在导数展开的一阶项中，有效作用量包含一个具有量子化系数的项，该系数编码了超流体凝聚体角动量的贝里相位；由此单一项可推导出相对论性Mermin-Ho关系、反常埃廷豪森效应（可转化为反常霍尔效应）以及反常霍尔黏度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在导数展开的一阶项中，有效作用量包含一个具有量子化系数的项，该系数编码了超流体凝聚体角动量的贝里相位；由此单一项可推导出相对论性Mermin-Ho关系、反常埃廷豪森效应（可转化为反常霍尔效应）以及反常霍尔黏度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 有效场论（effective field theory）方法，具体采用导数展开（derivative expansion）构建有效作用量，并分析其中量子化系数的物理后果。

papers.title: Entanglement of excited states after measurements in conformal field theory
papers.abstract: We study the entanglement of low-energy excited states after a fixed-outcome projective measurement on a spatial interval in a (1+1)-dimensional conformal field theory (CFT). The post-selected measurement outcome is represented by a slit carrying a conformal boundary condition, while excited states are introduced by operator insertions in the Euclidean path integral. After mapping the replicated slit geometry to a disk, the excited-state contribution to the post-measurement Rényi entropy is expressed as a normalized boundary-CFT correlation function. We apply this framework to the compact free boson CFT. For the chiral current excitation, the relevant ratios are given by current hafnians. We also study coherent superpositions of $J$ and $\bar J$, and of conjugate compact vertex operators. In the conjugate-vertex case, the ordinary-cylinder second Rényi ratio is independent of the relative phase, whereas the finite-slit post-measurement ratio contains phase-sensitive interference terms. Finally, we describe free-fermion and multi-Slater determinant methods for testing these predictions in the critical XX chain.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：conformal field theory (CFT)、Euclidean path integral、boundary-CFT correlation function。；研究对象：(1+1)维共形场论（CFT）中，在空间区间上进行固定结果的投影测量后，低能激发态的纠缠性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 后选择测量后的Rényi熵中，激发态贡献可表示为归一化的边界CFT关联函数；对于紧致自由玻色子CFT，手征流激发对应的比值为电流的hafnian；对于共轭顶点算符，有限区间测量后的第二Rényi比值包含相位敏感的干涉项，而普通圆柱上的比值则与相对相位无关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：后选择测量后的Rényi熵中，激发态贡献可表示为归一化的边界CFT关联函数；对于紧致自由玻色子CFT，手征流激发对应的比值为电流的hafnian；对于共轭顶点算符，有限区间测量后的第二Rényi比值包含相位敏感的干涉项，而普通圆柱上的比值则与相对相位无关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：通过欧几里得路径积分中的算符插入引入激发态，将带有共形边界条件的狭缝（代表后选择测量结果）映射到圆盘，利用边界CFT关联函数计算后测量Rényi熵。具体应用：紧致自由玻色子CFT，并描述用于临界XX链检验的费米子与多Slater行列式方法。

papers.title: Infrared Divergences as Itinerant Vacua
papers.abstract: Infrared divergences (IRDs) are usually treated as pathologies to be cancelled, regularized, or hidden in dressed asymptotic states. This paper develops a complementary and constructive viewpoint: an IRD is the signature of an \emph{itinerant vacuum} -- a quantum vacuum that wanders continuously through a family of inequivalent states as a classical order parameter evolves. Each value of the order parameter carries its own coherent vacuum, so moving the order parameter means traversing a succession of orthogonal vacua. The IRD is the field-theoretic cost of this wandering, and the $1/f$ noise, gravitational memory, and non-Gaussian fluctuations that emerge from it are its observable classical remnants. The technical core is an exact separation in the real-time closed-time-path (CTP) effective action. The infrared-divergent imaginary part of the influence functional must not be left as a divergent coefficient in a deterministic equation of motion; it is instead converted, by a Hubbard--Stratonovich identity, into a classical stochastic source. This step is an algebraic identity of the generating functional and requires no prior coarse graining or decoherence assumption: the retarded kernel encodes the memory of past vacuum transitions, while the noise kernel encodes the quantum uncertainty of the next one. We apply this construction to four parallel arenas -- soft QED, scalar fields in de Sitter space, soft gravitons, and non-equilibrium phase transitions -- and show that the same itinerant-vacuum mechanism underlies $1/f$ current noise, the primordial power spectrum, gravitational memory, and order-parameter dynamics. A geometric formulation in terms of a Hilbert-space bundle over the vacuum manifold is outlined as an outlook.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：理论框架、有效作用量、代数恒等式、几何表述。；研究对象：红外发散（Infrared Divergences, IRDs）及其在多个物理体系中的统一机制，包括软QED、德西特空间中的标量场、软引力子以及非平衡相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 红外发散并非需要消除的病态，而是“游走真空”（itinerant vacuum）的标志——当经典序参量演化时，量子真空连续遍历一系列不等价真空态，红外发散正是这一游走过程的场论代价，其经典残余表现为1/f噪声、引力记忆和非高斯涨落。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：红外发散并非需要消除的病态，而是“游走真空”（itinerant vacuum）的标志——当经典序参量演化时，量子真空连续遍历一系列不等价真空态，红外发散正是这一游走过程的场论代价，其经典残余表现为1/f噪声、引力记忆和非高斯涨落。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于实时闭时路径（Closed-Time-Path, CTP）有效作用量进行精确分离：将影响泛函的红外发散虚部通过Hubbard-Stratonovich恒等式转化为经典随机源，无需预先粗粒化或退相干假设；并应用于软QED、德西特空间标量场、软引力子和非平衡相变四个平行体系。

papers.title: ML and AI for density functional theory: different priorities for Kohn-Sham and orbital-free DFT, for electronic and nuclear DFT
papers.abstract: We overview similarities and, importantly, differences in computational bottlenecks and accuracy requirements that can be addressed with machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) techniques in electronic and nuclear DFT. From these follow different promising methodological and algorithmic choices depending on whether one machine learns the exchange correlation (XC) functional, the kinetic energy functional (KEF), the density or the basis functions. In particular, while the popular deep neural networks remain a potent choice in the context of KS DFT, we highlight their disadvantages when building KEFs and highlight conceptual advantages - yet to be fully realized - of symbolic regression for both electronic and nuclear DFT. We point out promising approaches that can be carried from the more extensively investigated ML-enhanced electronic DFT to nuclear DFT.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/综述文章。关键词：overview（综述）、methodological and algorithmic choices（方法论与算法选择）、machine learning（机器学习）、DFT（密度泛函理论）。；研究对象：电子密度泛函理论（electronic DFT）与核密度泛函理论（nuclear DFT）中，使用机器学习（ML）和人工智能（AI）技术时的计算瓶颈与精度需求差异。具体涉及交换关联泛函（XC functional）、动能密度泛函（KEF）、电子密度或基函数的机器学习。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Kohn-Sham DFT（KS DFT）中，深度神经网络是有效选择；但在构建动能密度泛函（KEF）时，深度神经网络存在劣势，而符号回归（symbolic regression）在电子和核DFT中均具有概念优势（尽管尚未完全实现）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Kohn-Sham DFT（KS DFT）中，深度神经网络是有效选择；但在构建动能密度泛函（KEF）时，深度神经网络存在劣势，而符号回归（symbolic regression）在电子和核DFT中均具有概念优势（尽管尚未完全实现）。；创新点：系统比较了ML/AI在电子DFT与核DFT中的应用优先级差异，特别指出深度神经网络在构建动能泛函时的局限性，并首次明确建议将电子DFT中已广泛研究的ML增强方法迁移至核DFT领域。
papers.method_zh: 基于对电子DFT和核DFT中不同计算瓶颈与精度需求的比较分析，讨论适用于不同任务（如学习交换关联泛函、动能泛函、密度或基函数）的ML/AI方法，包括深度神经网络和符号回归。

papers.title: Coherent quantum control of dark excitons in hybrid metal organic chalchogenolates
papers.abstract: Artificial atom-like systems are a promising candidate for next generation quantum processing. Among them, dark excitons exhibit one of the longest lifetimes at high temperatures. Here, we demonstrate coherent control of dark excitonic states in metal-organic chalcogenolates (MOChas) by using an ultrafast pulse shaper at room temperature. These dark exciton states are optically accessed via two-photon absorption and directly read out with a four-wave mixing process. The system is described by a non-perturbative, two-photon Hamiltonian based on well-known atomic physics and applied to a three level system comprised of two dark excitons. Empirical and theoretical state specific optical access is shown via a simple optical pulse shape. The developed Hamiltonian-based description is a first step towards a quantum processing platform using three-level systems and two photon transitions, one example being dark excitons in the MOCha silver benzeneselenolate (mithrene). Simple conditions for gate operations are laid out and described.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要中提及“demonstrate coherent control...by using an ultrafast pulse shaper”（实验手段）以及“described by a non-perturbative, two-photon Hamiltonian”（理论框架）。；研究对象：金属有机硫族化合物（MOChas）中的暗激子，具体材料为银苯硒酚盐（mithrene）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在室温下实现了对MOChas中暗激子态的相干控制，并通过双光子吸收和四波混频过程进行光学访问与读出，为基于三能级系统和双光子跃迁的量子处理平台奠定了基础。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在室温下实现了对MOChas中暗激子态的相干控制，并通过双光子吸收和四波混频过程进行光学访问与读出，为基于三能级系统和双光子跃迁的量子处理平台奠定了基础。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用超快脉冲整形器实现相干控制，通过双光子吸收光学访问暗激子态，并利用四波混频过程直接读出。理论上采用基于原子物理的非微扰双光子哈密顿量描述三能级系统（包含两个暗激子）。

papers.title: Wei-Norman approach for non-Hermitian driven spin-$S$ systems and its application to defect freezing
papers.abstract: In the theoretical study of nonequilibrium non-Hermitian systems, obtaining exact analytical solutions for their nonadiabatic dynamics is highly desirable yet often challenging. In this work, we identify a class of non-Hermitian quantum systems where this difficulty can be substantially reduced. Employing the Wei-Norman approach, we show that for a spin-$S$ subject to a general non-Hermitian time-dependent drive, the matrix elements of the evolution operator can be expressed in closed analytical forms (via Jacobi polynomials) in terms of the corresponding spin-$1/2$ model. This approach is straightforward and accessible to nonspecialists in Lie algebra. As an application, we investigate a specific nonequilibrium non-Hermitian phenomenon known as defect freezing, i.e., the existence of excitations in the adiabatic limit, in spin-$S$ extensions of the $\mathcal{PT}$-symmetric Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model under linear quenches. We derive exact analytical expressions for the momentum-resolved excitation probabilities and the total excitation densities. Our results reveal that defect freezing occurs exclusively in momentum sectors that traverse the $\mathcal{PT}$-symmetry-broken region -- and thus pass through a pair of higher-order exceptional points (EPs) -- during the quench; notably, the excitation density exhibits a singularity at a critical value of the non-Hermiticity parameter. This work enriches the analytical toolkit for nonadiabatic dynamics in multi-level non-Hermitian systems and provides quantitative, testable predictions for defect freezing across higher-order EPs, possibly accessible on platforms such as electric circuit networks and photonic lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Wei-Norman approach、exact analytical solutions、theoretical study。；研究对象：非厄米驱动自旋-S 系统，以及其中的缺陷冻结（defect freezing）现象，具体应用于 PT 对称 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 模型的自旋-S 推广。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 缺陷冻结仅发生在淬火过程中穿越 PT 对称破缺区域（即经过一对高阶异常点）的动量扇区；激发密度在非厄米参数的临界值处出现奇异性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：缺陷冻结仅发生在淬火过程中穿越 PT 对称破缺区域（即经过一对高阶异常点）的动量扇区；激发密度在非厄米参数的临界值处出现奇异性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用 Wei-Norman 方法，将自旋-S 系统的时间演化算符矩阵元用 Jacobi 多项式表示为自旋-1/2 模型的闭合解析形式，并应用于线性淬火下的 PT 对称 SSH 模型，推导出动量分辨的激发概率和总激发密度的精确解析表达式。

papers.title: The Normalised Wigner Negativity Rate as a Second-Moment Probe of Infall in AdS$_3$
papers.abstract: In spread complexity, the average position of an operator along its Krylov chain, recovers the right radial momentum of an infalling particle in AdS, yet it is a measure of the first moment, irrespective of the spread of the wavepacket away from its classical trajectory. The rate of a normalized Krylov-Wigner negativity can be proposed as a diagnostic of the second moment of the boundary state that captures this spreading. Starting with the \emph{seed-normalized} Krylov-Wigner distribution -- that is, the Wigner transform of the descendant cloud, with the decaying return amplitude divided out -- we obtain an analytic Bessel form in the macroscopic limit and compute its total negativity explicitly. Retaining the Bessel variable all the way through, we find that the negativity goes as $\sinh^{4Δ}(πt/β)$, while the raw, seed-normalized state negativity saturates, as dictated by the $O(\sqrt{D})$ bound. Using the exact negative binomial statistics of the Krylov chain and the momentum dictionary of Caputa et al.~\cite{Caputa:2024}, the rate of the negativity scales as the growth rate of the Krylov variance at late time asymptotics \emph{if and only if} $Δ=1$, the Breitenlohner-Freedman saturating dimension in $AdS_3$. This dimensionality is special in that the negativity rate is the product of the proper radial position and momentum, $\mathcal{R} \propto \mathcal{C} P_ρ$, i.e., the rate of the tidal stretch of nearby geodesic falling into the horizon. We comment on the direction for future research, in particular the interpretation of the transverse string size operator in terms of the Krylov number operator through the common $SU(1,1)$ discrete series.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：spread complexity、Krylov chain、Wigner transform、analytic Bessel form、negative binomial statistics、SU(1,1) discrete series。；研究对象：AdS₃/CFT₂对偶中，边界算符的Krylov复杂度与黑洞内部粒子下落动力学之间的关系，特别是波包在经典轨迹附近展宽（第二矩）的量子信息诊断。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 归一化的Krylov-Wigner负性率（negativity rate）可作为边界态第二矩的探针，在AdS₃中仅当共形维数Δ=1（Breitenlohner-Freedman饱和维数）时，该负性率正比于径向位置与动量的乘积，即邻近测地线落入视界时的潮汐拉伸率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：归一化的Krylov-Wigner负性率（negativity rate）可作为边界态第二矩的探针，在AdS₃中仅当共形维数Δ=1（Breitenlohner-Freedman饱和维数）时，该负性率正比于径向位置与动量的乘积，即邻近测地线落入视界时的潮汐拉伸率。；创新点：首次将归一化的Krylov-Wigner负性率作为边界态第二矩（波包展宽）的诊断量，并揭示其在特定维数下与黑洞内部测地线潮汐拉伸率的直接对应关系。摘要未突出说明与已有复杂度研究（仅关注第一矩）的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用Krylov复杂度框架，定义并计算“种子归一化”Krylov-Wigner分布（扣除衰减回返振幅后的Wigner变换），在宏观极限下得到解析Bessel函数形式，并显式计算其总负性。利用Krylov链的负二项式统计以及Caputa等人的动量字典，分析负性率与Krylov方差增长率的渐近关系。

papers.title: Orthogonality Edges in Strong-Coupling Quantum Work Statistics
papers.abstract: Strong coupling to a reservoir can do more than shift, broaden, or dress the work peaks of a driven quantum system. When the reservoir is infrared singular, a sudden change of a local control parameter can alter the boundary condition seen by infinitely many low-energy modes, converting a quasiparticle-like threshold line into a many-body edge. We demonstrate this mechanism for the inclusive work distribution of the biased spin-boson model under a sudden bias inversion. In the independent-boson limit, the problem is exactly solvable and gives a sharp infrared classification: a super-Ohmic bath can retain a finite elastic threshold weight, whereas Ohmic and sub-Ohmic baths extinguish the elastic line through boundary orthogonality. At the Ohmic fixed point, the same exponent controls both the vanishing elastic residue and the low-work continuum. We then ask how this edge is resolved away from the static-boundary limit. Using displaced-basis exact diagonalization of logarithmically discretized baths, we find that finite tunnelling leaves an edge-like continuum over the accessible energy window, while separating two operational diagnostics of the threshold: the cumulative-continuum exponent extracted from $z$-interleaved spectra lies above the elastic-overlap exponent extracted from $z$-averaged overlaps, $θ_C>θ_Z$. We interpret this separation as a finite-energy crossover away from the static-boundary fixed point, not as evidence for a new asymptotic fixed point. The separation survives fitting-window variation, oscillator-cutoff checks, spectrum-size checks, and leave-one-$z$-out tests, while time-domain characteristic functions provide a compatible but non-decisive diagnostic. Finally, the same threshold edge controls the sampling cost of Jarzynski-type exponential averages, making rare low-work events increasingly important at low temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。关键词：exactly solvable（精确可解）、displaced-basis exact diagonalization（位移基精确对角化）、logarithmically discretized baths（对数离散化浴）。；研究对象：强耦合量子工作统计中的正交性边缘（Orthogonality Edge），具体以偏置自旋-玻色子模型（biased spin-boson model）在突然偏置反转下的包含性功分布（inclusive work distribution）为研究对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当储层具有红外奇异性时，突然改变局域控制参数可将准粒子型阈值线转变为多体边缘；在欧姆固定点，同一指数同时控制弹性残留的消失和低功连续谱；有限隧穿效应使边缘在可及能量窗口内表现为类边缘连续谱，并导致累积连续谱指数与弹性重叠指数分离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当储层具有红外奇异性时，突然改变局域控制参数可将准粒子型阈值线转变为多体边缘；在欧姆固定点，同一指数同时控制弹性残留的消失和低功连续谱；有限隧穿效应使边缘在可及能量窗口内表现为类边缘连续谱，并导致累积连续谱指数与弹性重叠指数分离。；创新点：首次揭示红外奇异储层可将功分布中的准粒子阈值线转化为多体正交性边缘，并发现有限隧穿下两种阈值诊断指数（θ_C与θ_Z）的分离，将其解释为远离静态边界不动点的有限能量交叉行为，而非新渐近不动点的证据。
papers.method_zh: 独立玻色子极限下的精确可解分析；位移基精确对角化方法处理对数离散化浴；通过z交错谱提取累积连续谱指数θ_C，通过z平均重叠提取弹性重叠指数θ_Z；进行拟合窗口变化、振荡器截断检查、谱大小检查和留一z检验等数值验证；时域特征函数作为辅助诊断。

papers.title: Disentangling Haldane Phase by Generalized Clifford Circuits
papers.abstract: Disentangling transformations play a central role in the classical simulation of quantum many-body systems, yet their analytic structure and underlying mechanism remain largely unexplored. Here, we study the structure of the disentangler in the Haldane phase of spin-1 systems using generalized Clifford circuits. To this end, we extend the Clifford-circuit-augmented matrix product states (CAMPS)-based density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) method to spin-1 systems. Within this framework, we find that the local disentanglers optimized for the Haldane phase implement the generalized Kramers--Wannier (KW) transformation, and we analytically verify its optimality for the Affleck--Kennedy--Lieb--Tasaki (AKLT) state. Beyond reducing entanglement, the KW transformation maps the Haldane phase to a phase with spontaneously broken $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$ symmetry. This mapping is distinct from the Kennedy--Tasaki transformation and provides a new unitary route from symmetry-protected topological order to symmetry breaking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：generalized Clifford circuits、matrix product states、density-matrix renormalization group、analytically verify。；研究对象：自旋-1系统的Haldane相，特别是Affleck–Kennedy–Lieb–Tasaki（AKLT）态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 针对Haldane相优化的局域解纠缠子实现了广义Kramers–Wannier（KW）变换，该变换能将Haldane相映射到具有自发破缺Z₂对称性的相，提供了一条从对称性保护拓扑序到对称性破缺的新的幺正路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：针对Haldane相优化的局域解纠缠子实现了广义Kramers–Wannier（KW）变换，该变换能将Haldane相映射到具有自发破缺Z₂对称性的相，提供了一条从对称性保护拓扑序到对称性破缺的新的幺正路径。；创新点：发现并解析验证了Haldane相中的局域解纠缠子对应于广义Kramers–Wannier变换，该变换与已知的Kennedy–Tasaki变换不同，为理解拓扑序与对称性破缺之间的映射提供了新的幺正途径。
papers.method_zh: 使用基于Clifford电路增强的矩阵乘积态（CAMPS）的密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）方法，并将其扩展到自旋-1系统；通过广义Clifford电路分析解纠缠子的解析结构。

papers.title: On the structure of black hole interior in a model of scalar quasi-particles within the GR framework
papers.abstract: We propose an effective, singularity-free model of the black hole interior described entirely by a scalar field with a non-linear self-interaction potential. The interior consists of three layers -- a core, a transition layer, and a crust -- each fixed by the local quasi-particle density and the corresponding extremum of the potential of the field. The crust is a layer of massive, positive-energy thermal excitations above the zero-potential well, beneath a genuine Schwarzschild horizon at $r = 2GM_{\rm ADM}$. The core is an AdS-type region of negative energy density, it simulates a condensate of quasi-particles which carry zero classical kinetic energy and form a negative potential well governed by a negative inverse temperature parameter. The two regions are joined through Israel matching across the transition layer, which sits at an approximately null-gravity hypersurface of maximal regular matter density and where both the sign of the energy density and the type of thermal excitations change. Solving the static Einstein equations, we obtain the metric and mass functions of each layer, the edge equation of state of the crust, the linear stability condition of the null-gravity surface for ordinary and effectively negative mass matter, and the two-temperature thermodynamics linking the kinetic excitations to the negative temperature ground state. The framework unifies core and crust within a single field description and highlights the role of the negative energy AdS core and the associated negative temperature notion in describing black hole interior. In this picture the formation and Hawking evaporation of a black hole appear as a quasi-static cycle of an almost adiabatic thermodynamic engine, with the negative energy core as the working substance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose an effective model、solving the static Einstein equations、thermodynamics。；研究对象：黑洞内部结构，具体为在广义相对论框架下由标量准粒子描述的黑洞内部模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 黑洞内部由三层结构组成：负能量密度的AdS型核心、过渡层和正能量热激发壳层；核心具有负温度特性，整个黑洞的形成与霍金蒸发可视为一个准静态的绝热热力学循环。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：黑洞内部由三层结构组成：负能量密度的AdS型核心、过渡层和正能量热激发壳层；核心具有负温度特性，整个黑洞的形成与霍金蒸发可视为一个准静态的绝热热力学循环。；创新点：首次将黑洞内部统一描述为具有负温度基态的负能量AdS核心与正能量热激发壳层的组合，并将黑洞形成与蒸发过程解释为以负能量核心为工作物质的准静态绝热热力学循环。
papers.method_zh: 采用有效场论方法，通过具有非线性自相互作用势的标量场描述黑洞内部；求解静态爱因斯坦方程得到各层的度规和质量函数；利用Israel匹配条件连接核心与壳层；分析零引力面的线性稳定性条件；建立双温度热力学框架。

papers.title: Circle of Alpha-Particle Cluster Shapes in Neon-20
papers.abstract: Quantum states of Neon-20 are generally agreed to lie in rotational-vibrational bands of a cluster of five alpha particles. However, more than one cluster shape has been proposed as dominant at low energy. As relative motion within a cluster is soft in certain directions, we investigate how the low-lying rotational bands of Neon-20 can arise from a circle of clusters connecting favoured shapes: a triangular bipyramid, a square pyramid, and a $D_{2d}$-symmetric distorted tetrahedron -- a twisted bow-tie. Motion around the circle extends the Berry pseudo-rotation that connects differently oriented bipyramids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“investigate”、“extend”等理论分析词汇，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：氖-20（Neon-20）原子核中由五个α粒子（即氦-4原子核）构成的团簇结构及其低能旋转振动能带。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氖-20的低能旋转能带可以来源于一个连接三种有利团簇形状（三角双锥、四方锥和D2d对称扭曲四面体——即扭曲蝴蝶结）的“团簇形状圆环”，该圆环上的运动扩展了连接不同取向双锥体的Berry赝转动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氖-20的低能旋转能带可以来源于一个连接三种有利团簇形状（三角双锥、四方锥和D2d对称扭曲四面体——即扭曲蝴蝶结）的“团簇形状圆环”，该圆环上的运动扩展了连接不同取向双锥体的Berry赝转动。；创新点：提出氖-20的低能旋转能带并非由单一团簇形状主导，而是由连接多种有利形状的连续变形路径（圆环）上的集体运动产生，从而统一了此前被认为相互竞争的几种团簇构型。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体为基于团簇形状空间中的连续变形（圆环路径）来研究低能旋转能带的起源，涉及Berry赝转动概念的推广。

papers.title: Runaway electron induced explosions of graphite; modeling versus controlled DIII-D experiments
papers.abstract: The state-of-the-art concerning the modeling of the thermomechanical response of graphite to runaway electron (RE) impact is based on one-way coupled linear thermoelasticity combined with Rankine's strength-based failure criterion and limited to the onset of material failure. Here, the predictive capabilities are extended to the nonlinear damage phase characterized by material fragmentation and debris expulsion. This is achieved by introducing plasticity via the Johnson-Holmquist constitutive model, adopting an effective plastic strain-based failure criterion and coupling finite element analysis with smoothed-particle hydrodynamics. The extended thermomechanical model is successfully benchmarked against the results of two controlled RE-induced damage experiments recently carried out in DIII-D. This constitutes an important step towards the final objective of quantitatively describing the thermomechanical response of tungsten to REs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（结合实验验证）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“建模”（modeling）、“有限元分析”（finite element analysis）、“光滑粒子流体动力学”（smoothed-particle hydrodynamics），并与DIII-D实验进行基准对比（benchmarked against experiments）。；研究对象：石墨（graphite）在逃逸电子（runaway electron, RE）冲击下的热力学响应，具体包括材料损伤、碎片化和抛射（material fragmentation and debris expulsion）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入Johnson-Holmquist本构模型和基于有效塑性应变的失效准则，将逃逸电子冲击石墨的热力学响应建模从线性弹性阶段成功扩展至非线性损伤阶段，并在DIII-D受控实验中验证了模型预测能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入Johnson-Holmquist本构模型和基于有效塑性应变的失效准则，将逃逸电子冲击石墨的热力学响应建模从线性弹性阶段成功扩展至非线性损伤阶段，并在DIII-D受控实验中验证了模型预测能力。；创新点：将逃逸电子冲击石墨的建模从仅能描述材料失效起始（onset of material failure）的一维耦合线性热弹性模型，扩展至能描述碎片化和抛射的非线性损伤阶段。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用Johnson-Holmquist本构模型引入塑性，结合基于有效塑性应变的失效准则，并将有限元分析（FEA）与光滑粒子流体动力学（SPH）耦合进行数值模拟。实验验证基于DIII-D托卡马克中两次受控逃逸电子损伤实验。

papers.title: Quench, Glow, or Stay Silent: Distance-Controlled Up-Conversion Emission near Metallic Nanowires
papers.abstract: We demonstrate controlled transitions between competing radiative and nonradiative decay channels in the up-conversion luminescence of NaYF4:Er3+/Yb3+ nanocrystals placed in proximity to metallic nanowires. The nanocrystal-nanowire separation is used as a key control parameter governing the optical response. An essential aspect of our approach is the removal of inhomogeneous residual polymer layers from the nanowires, eliminating any compromise on distance control and reproducibility in emitter-metal hybrid nanostructures. Replacing them with a well-defined polymer spacer yields controlled access to three qualitatively distinct interaction regimes: luminescence quenching, plasmonic enhancement, and effective decoupling. Transitions between these regimes are shown to reflect changes in the dominant energy relaxation pathways: from nonradiative losses in direct contact with the metal, through modification of the local photonic density of states and coupling to plasmon-mediated modes, to behavior characteristic of quasi-isolated emitters. The plasmonic origin of the emission enhancement in the intermediate regime is evidenced by an increase in luminescence intensity accompanied by shortened decay times, as revealed by fluorescence lifetime imaging microscopy of up-conversion nanocrystals. All experiments were performed on single nanostructures, thereby excluding artefacts arising from aggregation effects and strengthening the interpretation of the observed phenomena. The presented approach provides controlled access to plasmon-modified decay channels and offers a basis for the rational design of functional nanophotonic and sensing structures with tailored optical properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、experiments、fluorescence lifetime imaging microscopy、single nanostructures。；研究对象：NaYF4:Er3+/Yb3+上转换纳米晶与金属纳米线构成的混合纳米结构，具体研究纳米晶-纳米线间距调控的上转换发光行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过精确控制纳米晶与金属纳米线之间的间距，可以实现三种截然不同的相互作用态：发光猝灭、等离激元增强和有效退耦合，分别对应非辐射损耗、局域光子态密度调控及准孤立发射体行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过精确控制纳米晶与金属纳米线之间的间距，可以实现三种截然不同的相互作用态：发光猝灭、等离激元增强和有效退耦合，分别对应非辐射损耗、局域光子态密度调控及准孤立发射体行为。；创新点：首次通过去除金属纳米线上不均匀的残余聚合物层，解决了发射体-金属混合纳米结构中距离控制与可重复性受损的问题，从而实现了对三种不同相互作用态的可靠访问，并排除了聚集效应带来的伪影。
papers.method_zh: 采用单纳米结构荧光寿命成像显微镜（FLIM）测量上转换纳米晶的发光强度和衰减时间；通过去除纳米线上不均匀的残余聚合物层并替换为定义明确的聚合物间隔层，实现纳米晶-纳米线间距的精确控制。

papers.title: On the Nonlinear Sensitivity of Phononic Frequency Combs to Physical Perturbations
papers.abstract: Phononic frequency combs offer a rich platform for nonlinear sensing, yet how their observable properties respond to changes in physical parameters remains poorly understood. Using a reduced two-mode autoparametric resonance model, we investigate how primary and secondary detuning, drive amplitude, and relative damping jointly shape amplitude and frequency sensitivity across the nonlinear parameter space. We find that sensitivity is far from uniform: primary detuning shifts the comb response smoothly, secondary detuning produces sharply localized transitions near resonance manifolds, and drive amplitude concentrates peak sensitivity close to the activation threshold rather than deep within the comb state. The relative damping redistributes energy continuously between modes without introducing discontinuities. The nonlinear sensitivity of amplitude and frequency observables across all parameters points to a common physical origin in autoparametric resonance, nonlinear saturation, and coupling-induced synchronization, offering a coherent basis for designing nonlinear sensing platforms with deliberate, parameter-aware sensitivity engineering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用“reduced two-mode autoparametric resonance model”（简化双模自参量共振模型）进行理论分析，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：声子频率梳（phononic frequency combs）在物理扰动下的非线性灵敏度特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 声子频率梳的振幅和频率灵敏度在参数空间中远非均匀：主失谐产生平滑响应，次失谐在共振流形附近产生尖锐局域跃迁，驱动振幅在激活阈值附近而非梳态深处集中峰值灵敏度。所有参数的非线性灵敏度均源于自参量共振、非线性饱和与耦合诱导同步的共同物理机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：声子频率梳的振幅和频率灵敏度在参数空间中远非均匀：主失谐产生平滑响应，次失谐在共振流形附近产生尖锐局域跃迁，驱动振幅在激活阈值附近而非梳态深处集中峰值灵敏度。所有参数的非线性灵敏度均源于自参量共振、非线性饱和与耦合诱导同步的共同物理机制。；创新点：揭示了声子频率梳灵敏度在非线性参数空间中的非均匀分布规律，并指出其物理起源的统一性，为设计具有参数感知灵敏度的非线性传感平台提供了理论基础。
papers.method_zh: 采用简化双模自参量共振模型，系统分析主失谐、次失谐、驱动振幅和相对阻尼四个参数对振幅与频率灵敏度的联合影响。

papers.title: Holographic heat engines for Schwarzschild black holes
papers.abstract: We construct reversible black hole heat engines in asymptotically flat spacetime using quasi-local gravitational thermodynamics. We enclose a Schwarzschild black hole in a finite spherical cavity and identify the working substance with the dual thermal system on the cavity boundary. The surface pressure and boundary area define a thermodynamic pressure-volume pair in the dual system, while all coupling constants of the gravitational theory remain fixed. We derive exact efficiencies for the Carnot, Otto, Diesel, Brayton, and Stirling engines and compare them numerically. These efficiencies probe the quasi-local equations of state of the black hole. The regenerated Stirling efficiency remains remarkably close to the Carnot bound and approaches it in the high-temperature limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“quasi-local gravitational thermodynamics”、“derive exact efficiencies”、“theoretical framework”。；研究对象：Schwarzschild黑洞的热力学系统，具体为在渐近平坦时空中置于有限球形腔内的黑洞，其工作物质为腔边界上的对偶热系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在准局域引力热力学框架下，构建了可逆黑洞热机，并推导出Carnot、Otto、Diesel、Brayton和Stirling五种循环的精确效率。其中，带再生的Stirling效率非常接近Carnot效率，并在高温极限下趋近于Carnot界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在准局域引力热力学框架下，构建了可逆黑洞热机，并推导出Carnot、Otto、Diesel、Brayton和Stirling五种循环的精确效率。其中，带再生的Stirling效率非常接近Carnot效率，并在高温极限下趋近于Carnot界。；创新点：首次在渐近平坦时空中利用准局域热力学构造可逆黑洞热机，并系统计算了多种热机循环的精确效率，揭示了再生Stirling效率与Carnot效率的接近关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用准局域引力热力学理论，将Schwarzschild黑洞置于有限球形腔内，以腔边界上的对偶热系统作为工作物质，定义表面压力与边界面积为热力学压力-体积对，固定所有引力理论耦合常数，推导并数值比较不同热机循环的效率。

papers.title: The Informational Cost of Structure: Representational Complexity in Networked Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract: How much information is required to represent a dynamical system in terms of an interaction structure and an evolution rule? We address this question using algorithmic information theory. We introduce Representational Complexity, the excess description length of a structure-plus-rule model relative to the shortest possible description of the dynamics itself. This intrinsic description defines a universal lower bound: no exact structural representation can be more concise. If arbitrary rules are allowed, graphs, hypergraphs, and other formalisms can all reach this bound by shifting information between structure and dynamics, so expressiveness alone cannot distinguish them. Meaningful differences arise only when scientific modeling restricts the admissible structures and rules. Within this setting, we identify conditions under which graph and hypergraph descriptions are informationally equivalent, and show how graph-preferred, hypergraph-preferred, and mixed regimes can emerge when those conditions are relaxed. Because Kolmogorov complexity is not computable, we complement the formal results with explicit description-length estimates. Our framework reframes the choice of network representation as a question of informational cost and mechanistic transparency rather than universal expressive power.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“algorithmic information theory”（算法信息论）、“Kolmogorov complexity”（柯尔莫哥洛夫复杂度）等理论工具，并进行了形式化推导和条件分析，未提及任何实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：网络化动力系统的结构表示问题。具体而言，研究的是如何用“相互作用结构”（如网络图、超图）和“演化规则”来表征一个动力学系统，并量化这种表示所需的信息成本。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了“表示复杂度”（Representational Complexity）这一概念，作为任何精确结构表示所需信息量的普适下界。发现当允许任意演化规则时，图、超图等不同表示形式在信息效率上是等价的；只有当科学建模对结构和规则施加限制时，不同表示形式之间才会出现信息成本的差异，并可能产生“图偏好”、“超图偏好”或“混合”等不同表示模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了“表示复杂度”（Representational Complexity）这一概念，作为任何精确结构表示所需信息量的普适下界。发现当允许任意演化规则时，图、超图等不同表示形式在信息效率上是等价的；只有当科学建模对结构和规则施加限制时，不同表示形式之间才会出现信息成本的差异，并可能产生“图偏好”、“超图偏好”或“混合”等不同表示模式。；创新点：将网络表示的选择问题从“哪种表示更具表达力”重新定义为“哪种表示的信息成本更低且机制更透明”。通过引入信息论下界，严格区分了不同表示形式在普适表达力上的等价性与在受限建模条件下的实际差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用算法信息论（Algorithmic Information Theory）作为理论框架，核心工具是柯尔莫哥洛夫复杂度（Kolmogorov Complexity）。通过比较“结构+规则”模型的描述长度与动力学本身的最短描述长度来定义“表示复杂度”。由于柯尔莫哥洛夫复杂度不可计算，论文还辅以显式的描述长度估计作为补充。

papers.title: Cellular Adaptation to Signal Fluctuations as Learning
papers.abstract: Cells represent one of the most fundamental units of life. Underlying their robust performance against environmental variability, such as temporal fluctuations of chemical signals, between different cell types, is a dynamical interrelation between the two components of an intracellular pathway: a gene-regulatory network and its upstream signal transducers. To understand how a single cell utilizes this feedback to self-regulate its gene-expressions, we develop a multiscale model of the pathway's components, in which the adaptive variables responsible for signal interpretation follow a feedback-induced learning process. We then derive a macroscopic theory capturing the covariations between these components - so-called collective modes. Our theory shows how cells can achieve robust output against signal fluctuations via self-regulation rather than simple noise suppression. Such robustness corresponds to a transition from random- to structured collective modes beyond a critical adaptation rate.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：multiscale model、macroscopic theory、feedback-induced learning process。；研究对象：细胞内信号通路中基因调控网络与上游信号转导子之间的动态耦合关系，以及细胞如何通过自适应机制应对化学信号的时间波动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 细胞可以通过自调节而非简单的噪声抑制，实现对信号波动的鲁棒输出；这种鲁棒性对应于在临界适应速率以上，从随机集体模式向结构化集体模式的转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：细胞可以通过自调节而非简单的噪声抑制，实现对信号波动的鲁棒输出；这种鲁棒性对应于在临界适应速率以上，从随机集体模式向结构化集体模式的转变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 构建了信号通路组分的多尺度模型，其中负责信号解释的自适应变量遵循反馈诱导的学习过程；并推导出描述这些组分之间协变关系的宏观理论（集体模式）。

papers.title: Thermalization hierarchy from irreducible degrees of freedom
papers.abstract: The decomposition of the Hilbert space of a quantum many-body system into the irreducible representations of its bond and commutant algebras yields a finer structure of dynamically isolated subspaces than the mere decomposition into symmetry sectors. While it has been recognized that subspaces associated with low bond-irrep dimensions $D_λ$ tend to violate the eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (ETH), here we show that $D_λ$ controls thermalization continuously across the full spectrum of dynamical subspaces. Using SU(2)-symmetric spin-1/2 chains as a paradigmatic example, we demonstrate that $\mathrm{log} \ D_λ$ quantitatively accounts for the average eigenstate entanglement entropy within each sector, establishing a thermalization hierarchy that interpolates from exact quantum many-body scars at $D_λ=1$ to volume-law ergodic states at large $D_λ$. To make this concrete, we introduce the notion of irreducible degrees of freedom (IDOF), defined as the number of independently-varying spatial coordinates parametrizing a many-body state within a given bond-algebra sector, which provides a microscopic interpretation of $D_λ$ and of the resulting thermalization hierarchy. Finally, we show that by selectively breaking symmetries while preserving chosen bond-algebra sectors, one can embed families of nonthermal eigenstates at prescribed entanglement levels into an otherwise ergodic spectrum, generalizing restricted spectrum-generating algebras from towers of individual states to entire dynamical subspaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：decomposition of Hilbert space、irreducible representations、bond and commutant algebras、eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (ETH)。；研究对象：SU(2)对称的自旋-1/2链中的量子多体系统，具体研究其动力学孤立子空间的热化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现 bond-irrep 维数 \( D_\lambda \) 的对数（\(\log D_\lambda\)）能够定量解释每个扇区中平均本征态纠缠熵，从而建立了一个从精确量子多体疤痕（\(D_\lambda=1\)）到体积律遍历态（大 \(D_\lambda\)）的热化层级结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现 bond-irrep 维数 \( D_\lambda \) 的对数（\(\log D_\lambda\)）能够定量解释每个扇区中平均本征态纠缠熵，从而建立了一个从精确量子多体疤痕（\(D_\lambda=1\)）到体积律遍历态（大 \(D_\lambda\)）的热化层级结构。；创新点：首次提出 bond-irrep 维数 \( D_\lambda \) 是连续控制整个动力学子空间谱系热化程度的定量指标，并引入“不可约自由度”（IDOF）作为其微观解释；同时展示了通过选择性破缺对称性，可以在遍历谱中嵌入具有指定纠缠水平的非热本征态族，将受限谱生成代数从单个态推广到整个动力学子空间。
papers.method_zh: 利用 bond 代数和交换子代数的不可约表示对希尔伯特空间进行分解，引入“不可约自由度”（IDOF）概念，并通过 SU(2) 对称自旋-1/2链作为范例进行理论分析。

papers.title: A high-sensitivity resistance bridge for nanoscale thermal microscopy
papers.abstract: Measurements of heat flux between micro-objects, in vacuum or in air, are challenging because of their small size and the low thermal conductance of the medium between them. One way to address this issue consists in using a scanning thermal microscope (SThM) equipped with a temperature dependent resistance thermometer. However, this requires an instrument able to both injecting a defined heating Joule power and performing highly-sensitive resistance measurements. Here, we present such an instrument based on a Wheatstone bridge equipped with three Kelvin arms. It can perform resistance measurements in the range from 100 $Ω$ to 1000 $Ω$ not only in direct current but also in alternating current regimes at frequencies up to a few tenths of kHz. We first show that measurements of resistance standards are accurate to within one part in $10^4$ with a relative experimental standard deviation which can be as low as one part in $10^8$ for one second measurement. The instrument is then tested with a SThM thermometer. With the support of an electro-thermal model considering thermal time constants of the thermometer, we explain the frequency dependence of detected signals and optimize the measurement protocols of temperature and heat flux. By measuring sub-mK temperature variations, this instrument is then used to determine with a few nanowatts uncertainty the near-field radiative heat flux between a heated glass microsphere and a glass substrate, which is caused by the coupling of surface phonon-polaritons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：扫描热显微镜（SThM）、电阻桥、测量仪器。；研究对象：纳米尺度热显微镜中的热通量测量，具体涉及近场辐射热通量（由表面声子-极化激元耦合引起）在加热玻璃微球与玻璃基底之间的传递。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该研究开发了一种基于惠斯通电桥的高灵敏度电阻测量仪器，能够实现亚毫开尔文（sub-mK）温度变化测量，并以此在纳瓦（nanowatts）不确定度下测定了近场辐射热通量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该研究开发了一种基于惠斯通电桥的高灵敏度电阻测量仪器，能够实现亚毫开尔文（sub-mK）温度变化测量，并以此在纳瓦（nanowatts）不确定度下测定了近场辐射热通量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：基于三开尔文臂惠斯通电桥的电阻测量仪器，支持直流和交流（频率高达几十kHz）测量；结合电热模型分析热时间常数对信号频率依赖性的影响；用于扫描热显微镜（SThM）中的温度计。

papers.title: Semiclassical Langevin dynamics of long-range dissipative time crystals
papers.abstract: We develop a semiclassical Langevin approach to study finite-size effects in dissipative time-crystalline spin systems. For a spin-$1/2$ model with power-law Lindblad operators, we find finite-size oscillations exponentially decaying in time, and their decay rate decreases algebraically with system size in the long-range regime. The scaling exponent of this decay time provides a direct diagnostic of the robustness of the time-crystalline, and we find that this robustness extends beyond the range of power-law dissipation exponents where the system dynamics is mean-field in the thermodynamic limit. We also apply our approach to a spin-one model with local dissipation and long-range Hamiltonian interactions, formulating it in terms of Gell-Mann variables. In this case, finite-size stability is quantified through the deviation time from the mean-field behavior and the behavior of the dominant Fourier peak. We find that both quantities scale as a power law with the system size -- marking thereby a time-crystal behavior -- when the exponent of the power-law interaction is below a certain threshold, that turns out to be in agreement with previous cumulant-expansion findings. Our results show that semiclassical Langevin dynamics provides a useful finite-size probe of dissipative time crystals in regimes beyond exact Lindblad simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：semiclassical Langevin approach（半经典朗之万方法）、finite-size effects（有限尺寸效应）、dissipative time crystals（耗散时间晶体）。；研究对象：耗散时间晶体（dissipative time crystals）在自旋系统中的有限尺寸效应，具体包括自旋-1/2模型（具有幂律Lindblad算符）和自旋-1模型（具有局域耗散和长程哈密顿相互作用）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在耗散时间晶体系统中，有限尺寸振荡的衰减率随系统尺寸呈代数标度，该标度指数可直接诊断时间晶体的鲁棒性；在长程相互作用指数低于某一阈值时，系统表现出时间晶体行为，且该阈值与之前的累积展开结果一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在耗散时间晶体系统中，有限尺寸振荡的衰减率随系统尺寸呈代数标度，该标度指数可直接诊断时间晶体的鲁棒性；在长程相互作用指数低于某一阈值时，系统表现出时间晶体行为，且该阈值与之前的累积展开结果一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 半经典朗之万动力学方法（semiclassical Langevin dynamics），用于研究超越精确Lindblad主方程模拟范围的耗散时间晶体有限尺寸效应。对自旋-1模型，使用Gell-Mann变量进行公式化。

papers.title: Experimental and numerical study of the dynamics of sedimenting pairs of semi-flexible fibers close to attractive `aligned' relative configuration
papers.abstract: Dynamics of two short semi-flexible fibers settling under gravity in a viscous fluid are investigated at Reynolds numbers Re << 1. We focus on fibers initially relatively close to each other, and we check if later they approach an aligned horizontal configuration, previously identified numerically (Bukowicki and Ekiel-Jezewska, Soft Matter 46 (2019) 9379) as attractive for symmetric initial conditions of moderately elastic filaments. In our experiments, two semi-flexible ball chains sediment in a highly viscous silicone oil. They are initially straight and close to a parallel horizontal relative configuration. Their motion and shape deformation are recorded using two synchronized cameras. For most of the trials, ball chains stay together, with damped oscillations around the symmetric aligned configuration. For a few initial conditions, the ball chains move away horizontally or vertically. To study the behavior over a longer time, we perform numerical simulations, modeling moderately elastic filaments as chains of identical beads, with the centers of consecutive beads connected by springs and with the fibers' elastic resistance to bending. Different initial positions and orientations are considered. Their dynamics are determined by the multipole expansion of the Stokes equations, implemented in the precise Hydromultipole numerical code. For short times, we observe the similar dynamics of semi-flexible ball chains and moderately elastic filaments. We provide examples of long-time numerical simulations illustrating that elastic filaments close to each other can move away horizontally or vertically, but after a long time, come back and perform damped oscillations while approaching the aligned configuration with almost touching filament ends. We confirm the attractive nature of the aligned configuration of very close semi-flexible sedimenting fibers, even if they are far away from each other.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+数值模拟）。关键词：experiments, numerical simulations, Hydromultipole numerical code。；研究对象：半柔性纤维在粘性流体中沉降的动力学行为，具体关注两根短半柔性纤维在重力作用下、接近“对齐”相对构型时的运动与形变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两根非常接近的半柔性沉降纤维的“对齐”构型具有吸引性，即使初始相距较远，纤维在长时间后仍会趋向该构型并发生阻尼振荡，最终几乎端对端接触。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：两根非常接近的半柔性沉降纤维的“对齐”构型具有吸引性，即使初始相距较远，纤维在长时间后仍会趋向该构型并发生阻尼振荡，最终几乎端对端接触。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用两根半柔性球链在高粘度硅油中沉降，通过两台同步相机记录运动与形变；数值上采用多极展开求解斯托克斯方程（Hydromultipole数值代码），将纤维建模为弹性珠链（珠间弹簧连接，并考虑抗弯弹性）。

papers.title: Improving Jet A-1 Thermal-Oxidative Stability through Selective Removal of Unwanted Trace Species via 3.7 Å Chabazite Filtration
papers.abstract: The thermal stability of Jet A-1 fuel is strongly affected by trace heteroatomic species that promote thermal oxidative deposit formation, as well as antioxidant additives such as butylated hydroxytoluene, which preserve fuel stability. 3.7 Å chabazite is a tunable microporous adsorbent, but optimizing its composition requires balancing promoter removal against antioxidant loss. Here, we use density functional theory and \textit{ab initio} molecular dynamics (AIMD) to evaluate this trade-off using two compositional descriptors: framework acidity (Si/Al $= 35$--$8$) and bimetallic substitution (Co, Mg, Zn) at fixed Al content. Lowering Si/Al strengthens adsorption of all species, including BHT, confirming an intrinsic selectivity penalty for acidity-only tuning. In contrast, bimetallic substitution introduces chemically selective behavior, strengthening uptake of specific promoters while either suppressing or enhancing antioxidant adsorption depending on dopant identity. AIMD simulations at 400 K further show that adsorption energy alone is insufficient to describe calculated trends, because molecular mobility inside chabazite can influence residence time and effective capture during fuel treatment. Analysis of the density of states and the participating wavefunctions reveals signatures that are consistent with dopant-dependent adsorption shifts. These results establish a unified adsorption--transport--electronic screening framework for selecting chabazite compositions that remove deposit promoters while preserving antioxidant functionality in Jet A-1 treatment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用了密度泛函理论（DFT）和从头算分子动力学（AIMD）作为主要研究手段。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料、体系或物理现象是：通过3.7 Å菱沸石（Chabazite）过滤来选择性去除Jet A-1航空燃料中影响热氧化稳定性的微量杂原子物种（沉积促进剂）和抗氧化添加剂（如丁基羟基甲苯，BHT）的吸附与输运过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过双金属（Co, Mg, Zn）取代来调节菱沸石组成，可以实现对特定沉积促进剂的化学选择性吸附，同时抑制或增强抗氧化剂（BHT）的吸附，从而在去除有害物种和保留有益添加剂之间取得平衡。仅通过调节骨架酸性（Si/Al比）无法实现这种选择性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过双金属（Co, Mg, Zn）取代来调节菱沸石组成，可以实现对特定沉积促进剂的化学选择性吸附，同时抑制或增强抗氧化剂（BHT）的吸附，从而在去除有害物种和保留有益添加剂之间取得平衡。仅通过调节骨架酸性（Si/Al比）无法实现这种选择性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容推断，其创新点在于建立了一个统一的“吸附-输运-电子结构”筛选框架，用于指导菱沸石组成的选择，以在Jet A-1燃料处理中实现沉积促进剂与抗氧化剂的选择性分离。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用了基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的电子结构计算和从头算分子动力学（AIMD）模拟。具体分析了两种组成描述符：骨架酸性（Si/Al比从35到8）和固定Al含量下的双金属取代（Co, Mg, Zn）。通过计算吸附能、态密度（DOS）和参与波函数来评估吸附行为，并通过400 K下的AIMD模拟考察分子在菱沸石孔道内的迁移性。

papers.title: Mid-IR single- and dual-electro-optic comb generation with an ultrafast modulator
papers.abstract: Mid-infrared (mid-IR) frequency combs are powerful tools for molecular sensing, industrial monitoring, and precision spectroscopy, yet their development beyond 5 um remains limited. Electro-optic modulation offers a promising path toward compact, agile comb generation, but extending this approach into the mid-infrared has been hindered by the lack of practical, high-performance modulators. Here we present an approach that leads to efficient generation of mid infrared frequency combs around 9 um, by employing ultrafast, room temperature, free space electro optic intensity modulators. By driving a single modulator with short electrical pulse trains, we realize both single- and dual-comb operation from a continuous-wave quantum cascade laser, providing a compact and versatile platform for mid-IR spectroscopy. This scheme produces combs with tunable repetition rates down to the megahertz range with direct observation on an electrical spectrum analyzer without any interferometer. As a proof of concept, we perform single- and dual-comb spectroscopy of a germanium etalon and an ammonia cell, achieving resolution far beyond that of conventional Fourier-transform infrared (FTIR) spectrometers and highlighting the potential of this approach for precise measurements in the long-wavelength molecular-fingerprint region. These results establish high-performance mid-IR modulators as a promising route toward practical, energy-efficient frequency-comb systems for sensing and spectroscopy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验装置（自由空间电光强度调制器、连续波量子级联激光器）、实验操作（驱动短电脉冲序列）和实验验证（对锗标准具和氨气池进行光谱测量）。；研究对象：中红外（约9微米波长）频率梳的生成，具体采用电光调制方法，以连续波量子级联激光器为光源，实现单梳和双梳操作。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用超快、室温工作的自由空间电光强度调制器，在约9微米波长处高效生成了中红外频率梳，并实现了可调谐重复频率低至兆赫兹范围的单梳和双梳操作，其光谱分辨率远超传统傅里叶变换红外光谱仪。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用超快、室温工作的自由空间电光强度调制器，在约9微米波长处高效生成了中红外频率梳，并实现了可调谐重复频率低至兆赫兹范围的单梳和双梳操作，其光谱分辨率远超传统傅里叶变换红外光谱仪。；创新点：将电光调制频率梳技术成功拓展至中红外5微米以上波段（约9微米），克服了该波段缺乏实用高性能调制器的瓶颈，并实现了紧凑、可调谐的单梳/双梳操作，为长波分子指纹区的精密光谱测量提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：使用超快自由空间电光强度调制器，通过短电脉冲序列驱动单个调制器，对连续波量子级联激光器进行调制，直接用电谱分析仪观测梳齿，无需干涉仪。应用：对锗标准具和氨气池进行单梳和双梳光谱测量。

papers.title: Dissipative preparation and stabilization of d-mode multinomial cat states
papers.abstract: Engineering dissipation with tailored steady states has become a powerful approach for preparing and stabilizing quantum states. In this framework, engineered dissipative processes continuously steer a system towards desired target states while suppressing unwanted noise. However, extending this idea to multimode systems is challenging and remains largely unexplored, although this class of states is a powerful resource for quantum sensing and quantum information processing applications. Here, we propose a general method to design the required dissipative processes for the generation of multimode cat states in bosonic systems. We show that the engineered dissipation prepares such states from the vacuum with high fidelity and robustly stabilizes them against decoherence. As a result, their lifetime is extended by several orders of magnitude compared to natural decay times, which in turn enhances their applications in quantum techonologies. We specifically focus on the preparation and stabilization of two-mode binomial cat states and discuss a pathway for the implementation in superconducting circuit. However, our scheme can also scale up to arbitrary d-mode multinomial cat states associated to $\mathfrak{su}(d\ge2)$ algebras, and thus, our scalable framework provides a feasible route towards stabilizing compact nonclassical states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：propose a general method, design, engineered dissipation, theoretical framework）；研究对象：玻色子系统中多模猫态（multimode cat states）的耗散制备与稳定化，具体聚焦于双模二项式猫态（two-mode binomial cat states），并推广至任意d模多项式猫态（d-mode multinomial cat states）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过设计工程化耗散过程，可从真空态高保真度地制备多模猫态，并使其寿命相比自然衰减时间延长数个数量级，从而增强其在量子技术中的应用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过设计工程化耗散过程，可从真空态高保真度地制备多模猫态，并使其寿命相比自然衰减时间延长数个数量级，从而增强其在量子技术中的应用。；创新点：将耗散工程从单模系统扩展到多模系统，首次提出可扩展至任意d模多项式猫态的通用耗散制备与稳定化方案，填补了该领域此前缺乏系统性方法的空白。
papers.method_zh: 提出一种基于工程化耗散（engineered dissipation）的通用理论方法，利用与$\mathfrak{su}(d\ge2)$代数相关的耗散过程设计，实现多模猫态的制备与稳定化。具体讨论了在超导电路中的实现路径。

papers.title: Dark energy genesis: modeling dissipative effects in primordial cosmology
papers.abstract: In various approaches to quantum gravity, spacetime geometry is understood to emerge from more fundamental discrete structures at the Planck scale. As sometimes posited, their presence could lead to dissipative effects in the smooth effective sector. In this paper, we develop the idea of non-conservation in gravity, by introducing an effective cosmological model within unimodular gravity, in which a varying cosmological constant arises as a consequence of dissipation. We show that this requires to incorporate hidden degrees of freedom -- termed quantum gravity defects -- that act as an effective bath for the matter fields. To illustrate the viability of the framework, we study the case of an Ohmic bath inspired by the Caldeira-Leggett model for Brownian motion, leading to a diffusion equation for the matter energy density. The results show that, starting from a primordial universe with no dark energy, dissipation can account for the generation of a small positive cosmological constant.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：effective cosmological model、unimodular gravity、Caldeira-Leggett model。；研究对象：原初宇宙中暗能量的起源问题，具体研究引力理论中由耗散效应导致的宇宙学常数动态变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入量子引力缺陷作为有效热库，耗散效应可以在原初无暗能量的宇宙中产生一个小的正宇宙学常数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入量子引力缺陷作为有效热库，耗散效应可以在原初无暗能量的宇宙中产生一个小的正宇宙学常数。；创新点：将量子引力中可能存在的耗散效应（源于时空几何从普朗克尺度离散结构涌现）与暗能量生成联系起来，提出通过隐藏自由度（量子引力缺陷）作为热库来实现宇宙学常数的动态产生。
papers.method_zh: 采用单模引力（unimodular gravity）框架，引入耗散机制导致宇宙学常数变化；具体使用Caldeira-Leggett模型（布朗运动的欧姆热库模型）来模拟耗散，推导出物质能量密度的扩散方程。

papers.title: Griffiths Anomalous Absorption in Sparse-Loss Photonic Lattices
papers.abstract: Light absorption in photonic lattices with sparsely distributed loss sites exhibits behavior analogous to Griffiths physics. Under uniform excitation, the transmitted power shows a stretched-exponential decay and a non-monotonic dependence on the loss strength, with an optimal loss rate that maximizes absorption. This behavior arises from rare, long loss-free segments that act as weakly coupled, long-lived photonic channels, rather than from exceptional point physics or interference effects. Using a minimal tight-binding model with binary quenched dissipation, we show that rare regions produce a universal Griffiths-type subexponential decay. Sparse-loss photonic lattices thus provide an accessible platform to observe disorder-induced anomalous absorption and rare-region Griffiths physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（结合模型计算）。判断依据：使用“minimal tight-binding model with binary quenched dissipation”进行理论分析，未提及实验数据或具体实验手段。；研究对象：稀疏损耗光子晶格中的光吸收行为，特别是与Griffiths物理类似的异常吸收现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在稀疏分布损耗位点的光子晶格中，光透射功率呈现拉伸指数衰减，且吸收效率随损耗强度呈非单调变化，存在一个最优损耗率使吸收最大化。该现象源于稀有的长无损耗段形成的弱耦合长寿命光子通道，而非奇异点物理或干涉效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在稀疏分布损耗位点的光子晶格中，光透射功率呈现拉伸指数衰减，且吸收效率随损耗强度呈非单调变化，存在一个最优损耗率使吸收最大化。该现象源于稀有的长无损耗段形成的弱耦合长寿命光子通道，而非奇异点物理或干涉效应。；创新点：首次将Griffiths物理（通常与无序量子系统相关）引入光子晶格中的吸收问题，揭示了稀疏损耗体系中由稀有区域主导的亚指数衰减行为，并指出该平台可观测无序诱导的异常吸收。
papers.method_zh: 采用二元淬火耗散的最小紧束缚模型，通过理论分析研究稀疏损耗光子晶格中的光传输与吸收特性。

papers.title: Geometric modulation of transition and survival intensities in non-Hermitian systems
papers.abstract: The time evolution of non-Hermitian systems is generally nonunitary. Dynamics governed by time-dependent non-Hermitian Hamiltonians lead to a variety of novel phenomena, one of which is state amplification or suppression induced by the complex Berry phase. Here, we extend the framework of geometric modulation to multi-level systems and show that both transition and survival intensities can be modulated. We apply our theory to the non-Hermitian Landau-Zener (LZ) problem. First, we show that, in the half-LZ problem, both the transition and survival probabilities exhibit nonreciprocity due to the complex Berry phase. In the non-Hermitian standard LZ problem, only the survival intensity is known to exhibit nonreciprocity, whereas the transition intensity does not. However, the physical origin of this nonreciprocal behavior remains unclear. In this work, we show that the nonreciprocity originates from the complex Berry phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“extend the framework”“apply our theory”“show that”等理论推导与论证表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：非厄米系统中的多能级系统，具体应用于非厄米Landau-Zener（LZ）问题，包括半LZ问题和标准LZ问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了非厄米LZ问题中跃迁强度与存活强度的非互易性均源于复Berry相位，并证明通过几何调制可以调控多能级系统中的跃迁与存活强度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了非厄米LZ问题中跃迁强度与存活强度的非互易性均源于复Berry相位，并证明通过几何调制可以调控多能级系统中的跃迁与存活强度。；创新点：将几何调制框架从两能级系统扩展到多能级系统，并首次明确指出非厄米标准LZ问题中跃迁强度非互易性的物理起源是复Berry相位（此前仅存活强度的非互易性已知，但其起源未明）。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：几何调制（geometric modulation）方法，结合复Berry相位分析，应用于非厄米含时哈密顿量驱动的动力学过程。

papers.title: Out-of-distribution Neural Inference in Dynamical Ising Models
papers.abstract: Neural networks are increasingly used to infer hidden physical structure from dynamical observations, yet it remains unclear whether their out-of-distribution performance reflects transferable physical rule learning. We address this question in a controlled inverse problem: reconstructing interaction graphs of a kinetic Ising model from Glauber magnetization trajectories. Across convolutional, graph, Transformer, and hybrid architectures, we find that data-driven training produces distinct and reproducible statistical strategies under topology and temperature shifts. Edge-population diagnostics reveal that Transformer-based models tend to preserve the link density of the training ensemble, whereas convolutional models can collapse toward sparse- or no-link predictions that appear out-of-distribution stable by exploiting the majority no-link class. Thus, high in-distribution accuracy and apparent out-of-distribution robustness do not necessarily imply a learned dynamics-to-structure rule. Instead, neural reconstruction can be governed by architecture-dependent statistical priors. Our results identify a concrete failure mode of standard data-driven learning in physical inverse problems and motivate rule-guided principles for machine-learning-assisted scientific discovery.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：neural networks, inverse problem, data-driven training, statistical strategies。；研究对象：动力学Ising模型（kinetic Ising model）的相互作用图重构问题，具体从Glauber磁化轨迹中推断隐藏的物理结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 神经网络在动力学Ising模型逆问题中的分布外性能并不反映可迁移的物理规则学习，而是受架构依赖的统计先验支配；高分布内准确率和表观分布外鲁棒性可能掩盖对物理规则的真正理解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：神经网络在动力学Ising模型逆问题中的分布外性能并不反映可迁移的物理规则学习，而是受架构依赖的统计先验支配；高分布内准确率和表观分布外鲁棒性可能掩盖对物理规则的真正理解。；创新点：揭示了标准数据驱动学习在物理逆问题中的一个具体失败模式：模型可能利用多数无链接类别产生看似分布外稳定的稀疏或无链接预测，而非学习真正的动力学到结构的映射规则。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 使用卷积神经网络、图神经网络、Transformer及混合架构进行数据驱动训练，通过边群体诊断（edge-population diagnostics）分析不同拓扑和温度偏移下的统计策略。

papers.title: Community structure of the pseudofractal web
papers.abstract: The Ramsey community number $r_κ$ is the smallest network size at which a graph is better described by a partition into communities than by no partition, under a prescribed detection rule. On a scale-free graph this question is confounded: a block model can split the network merely to absorb its degree distribution. I compute $r_κ$ analytically for the deterministic pseudofractal scale-free web of Dorogovtsev, Goltsev, and Mendes, separating genuine community structure from degree heterogeneity with two closed-form detection rules. Under a plain Bernoulli stochastic block model, the web's natural recursive bipartition is unpreferred while small and breaks at $r_κ=1095$ nodes, with a log-evidence growing as $(\ln 3-\tfrac{2}{3}\ln 2)n$. Under a degree-corrected model tested against the configuration-model null, the same partition survives, breaking far earlier at $r_κ=42$, with a log-evidence growing as $(2\ln 3-\tfrac{4}{3}\ln 2)n$ -- exactly twice the plain slope, and independent of the prior. Degree correction reverses the ordering of the candidate cuts, demoting the hub-leaf split and elevating the recursive one. Because the web is self-similar, the best description is not two communities but a nested hierarchy: the degree-corrected evidence keeps rising as the partition is refined, and is maximised at of order $\sqrt{n}$ communities of $\sim\sqrt{n}$ nodes. A purely local recursive rule thus builds true hierarchical community structure, over and above the scale-free degree sequence it also produces, in an exactly solvable setting.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytically compute、closed-form detection rules、exactly solvable setting。；研究对象：伪分形标度网络（pseudofractal scale-free web of Dorogovtsev, Goltsev, and Mendes）中的社区结构（community structure）及其与度异质性（degree heterogeneity）的区分。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在伪分形网络上，真实的社区结构是嵌套层级式的，而非简单的二分；度修正模型（degree-corrected model）能有效区分社区结构与度分布效应，且最优社区数约为√n个，每个社区约含√n个节点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在伪分形网络上，真实的社区结构是嵌套层级式的，而非简单的二分；度修正模型（degree-corrected model）能有效区分社区结构与度分布效应，且最优社区数约为√n个，每个社区约含√n个节点。；创新点：在可精确求解的伪分形网络上，严格证明了度修正模型能反转候选分割的排序（将中心-叶子分割降级、递归分割提升），并揭示了纯局域递归规则可自发产生真正的层级社区结构，且该结构独立于网络本身产生的标度无标度度序列。
papers.method_zh: 解析计算：基于Ramsey社区数（Ramsey community number r_κ）的定义，分别采用普通伯努利随机块模型（plain Bernoulli stochastic block model）和度修正随机块模型（degree-corrected stochastic block model）与配置模型零假设（configuration-model null）进行对比，推导对数证据（log-evidence）的解析表达式。

papers.title: MatPhaseBench: A Semantics-Guided Benchmark for Materials Phase Diagrams Understanding
papers.abstract: Materials phase diagrams are a core knowledge representation in materials science, encoding temperature,composition, phase stability, and phase transformation pathways, with their full understanding requiring thermodynamic mechanism analysis and scientific reasoning. Although VLMs have shown promise in scientific image understanding, their systematic evaluation on such logically complex images demanding deep mechanistic interpretation remains limited, and phase diagrams provide a challenging testbed for this purpose. We introduce MatPhaseBench, a high-quality, high-reliability benchmark for complex scientific image understanding, focused on materials phase diagrams. MatPhaseBench is constructed from 3681 papers in classical materials science journals, from which 200 high-quality diagram-text pairs were selected, covering 189 material systems and 70 elements. The benchmark has three key features: (1)targeting complex scientific image understanding-it moves beyond simple objective tests to open-ended tasks requiring deep comprehension; (2)comprehensive image-text alignment-semantic information associated with images is fully preserved during literature mining and matching; (3) high-quality human-supervised text acquisition-all descriptions undergo strict manual validation. Experimental results show that current VLMs remain substantially behind expert-level understanding: they are largely limited to surface visual perception, lack deep reasoning grounded in thermodynamic mechanisms, have limited domain awareness and expert analytical experience, and perform poorly in distinguishing fine-grained differences in composite or multi-diagram settings. Overall, MatPhaseBench constitutes a challenging research-grade benchmark, providing a foundational platform for complex scientific image understanding, phase diagram analysis, and trustworthy multi-modal AI in science.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（基准构建与实验评估）。判断依据：benchmark、VLMs、experimental results、human-supervised text acquisition。；研究对象：材料相图（materials phase diagrams），涵盖189种材料体系、70种元素，涉及温度、成分、相稳定性及相变路径。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当前视觉语言模型（VLMs）在理解材料相图方面远未达到专家水平：主要局限于表面视觉感知，缺乏基于热力学机制的深层推理，领域知识和专家分析经验有限，在复合或多图场景中区分细粒度差异的能力较差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当前视觉语言模型（VLMs）在理解材料相图方面远未达到专家水平：主要局限于表面视觉感知，缺乏基于热力学机制的深层推理，领域知识和专家分析经验有限，在复合或多图场景中区分细粒度差异的能力较差。；创新点：提出了首个面向材料相图复杂科学图像理解的高质量、高可靠性基准（MatPhaseBench），其三大特色为：针对需要深度理解的开放任务、文献挖掘中完整保留图像-文本语义对齐、所有描述经严格人工验证。摘要未突出说明与已有基准的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 从3681篇经典材料科学期刊论文中筛选出200个高质量相图-文本对，构建基准数据集；采用人工监督的文本获取流程（所有描述经过严格人工验证）；使用多种VLMs进行实验评估。

papers.title: Holographic Learning from Fermionic Spectra: Application to Strange Metal Phenomenology
papers.abstract: We develop a data-driven framework based on Neural ODEs that learns the bulk metric functions and the $U(1)$ gauge potential of a static, planar-symmetric black hole from boundary fermionic spectral functions. After validating the framework on the Einstein--Maxwell and Gubser--Rocha models with high accuracy, we apply it to the strange metal phase of the cuprate $\mathrm{(Pb,Bi)_2Sr_{2-x}La_xCuO_{6+δ}}$ within a semi-holographic setting, taking as input the spectral data generated from the extended power-law liquid (PLL) model calibrated by angle-resolved photoemission measurements. At low temperatures and near-optimal doping, we show that the normalized extended PLL model can be well described by an effective representative of a conformal class near $\mathrm{AdS}_{2}\times\mathbb{R}^{2}$ black holes with a nearly vanishing gauge potential ($qA_t\sim10^{-4}\,\mathrm{eV}$). A key structural observation is that our probe fermion is massless and therefore insensitive to the conformal factor $Ω(z)$. This further implies that fixing the macroscopic thermodynamics such as the electronic specific heat would require independent input beyond the fermionic spectra. We also delineate the applicability boundaries of our framework: the learned effective model remains viable across doping at low temperatures, with the loss increasing mildly as the samples move away from the marginal Fermi liquid point toward the overdoped side; the principal limitation is temperature, where both the loss and $qA_t$ grow substantially.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：数据驱动框架、Neural ODEs、半全息模型、有效模型学习）；研究对象：铜氧化物超导体(Pb,Bi)₂Sr₂₋ₓLaₓCuO₆₊δ的奇异金属相，以及其费米子谱函数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低温近最佳掺杂下，由扩展幂律液体模型描述的奇异金属谱函数可被一个近AdS₂×ℝ²黑洞（规范势近乎为零，qA_t~10⁻⁴ eV）有效描述；探测费米子为无质量，因此对共形因子不敏感，需额外输入（如电子比热）才能固定宏观热力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低温近最佳掺杂下，由扩展幂律液体模型描述的奇异金属谱函数可被一个近AdS₂×ℝ²黑洞（规范势近乎为零，qA_t~10⁻⁴ eV）有效描述；探测费米子为无质量，因此对共形因子不敏感，需额外输入（如电子比热）才能固定宏观热力学。；创新点：首次将Neural ODEs用于从边界费米子谱函数全息地学习体度规和规范势，并成功应用于实际奇异金属材料谱数据，揭示了有效描述与近AdS₂×ℝ²黑洞的关联。
papers.method_zh: 基于神经常微分方程（Neural ODEs）的数据驱动框架，从边界费米子谱函数反演静态平面对称黑洞的度规函数和U(1)规范势；在爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦和Gubser-Rocha模型上验证精度后，结合半全息方法，以角分辨光电子能谱校准的扩展幂律液体模型生成的谱数据作为输入。

papers.title: Electron-beam Writing of Spectrally Uniform Green Single-photon Emitters in Hexagonal Boron Nitride
papers.abstract: Scalable quantum photonic technologies require single-photon emitters whose positions and emission energies can be engineered simultaneously. Hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) is an attractive room-temperature host, but deterministic creation of spectrally reproducible emitters remains challenging. Here, we use a standard scanning electron microscope as a direct-writing tool to activate bright green single-photon emitters in hBN at predefined sites, without ion implantation or post-fabrication thermal annealing. The written emitters exhibit reproducible zero-phonon-line emission centered near 536 nm, room-temperature antibunching with g(2)(0) as low as 0.08, high brightness, strong linear polarization, and stable emission. Thickness-dependent activation, stacking experiments, cathodoluminescence spectroscopy, and first-principles calculations support a carbon-related defect complex as the most plausible origin of the emission. As a proof of nanophotonic compatibility, we further activate emitters in a nanoparticle-on-mirror plasmonic nanocavity and observe photoluminescence enhancement accompanied by shortened emission lifetimes. These results establish electron-beam direct writing as a practical route to site-selective, spectrally uniform green quantum emitters in hBN, offering a promising basis for integrated room-temperature quantum photonic architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：electron-beam writing、scanning electron microscope、cathodoluminescence spectroscopy、first-principles calculations，实验为主，辅以计算）；研究对象：六方氮化硼（hBN）中的绿色单光子发射体，以及其在室温量子光子学中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用标准扫描电子显微镜作为直写工具，可在六方氮化硼中预定位点激活光谱均匀的绿色单光子发射体，其零声子线发射中心位于约536 nm，室温下g²(0)低至0.08，且无需离子注入或退火处理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用标准扫描电子显微镜作为直写工具，可在六方氮化硼中预定位点激活光谱均匀的绿色单光子发射体，其零声子线发射中心位于约536 nm，室温下g²(0)低至0.08，且无需离子注入或退火处理。；创新点：首次实现无需离子注入或退火，仅用标准扫描电子显微镜即可在六方氮化硼中定点写入光谱均匀的绿色单光子发射体，并验证了其与纳米光子结构的兼容性。
papers.method_zh: 扫描电子显微镜直写、阴极发光光谱、厚度依赖性激活实验、堆叠实验、第一性原理计算，以及纳米颗粒-镜面等离子体纳米腔中的光致发光增强与寿命测量。

papers.title: Reconfigurable Bitter-Type Electromagnet for Zeeman Slowing
papers.abstract: Many Zeeman slower magnets are geometrically captured by a vacuum chamber, preventing modification or repair without breaking vacuum. We describe a Bitter-type electromagnet coil design that can be easily disassembled, reconfigured, repaired, and replaced without disturbing the vacuum system. This coil, designed to slow lithium atoms, produces a near-ideal field profile with a single DC power supply. With a resistance of 5.7(9) m$Ω$, an inductance of 8.8(2) $μ$H, and switching times as low as $\sim100$ $μ$s, the coil compares favorably to other designs, and can be disassembled, modified, and reassembled repeatedly without loss of performance. With forced-air cooling, the coil experiences moderate heating. This coil design offers greater flexibility than traditional electromagnet designs, and it can retrofitted onto existing UHV chambers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：描述了一种具体线圈的设计、制造和性能测试（如电阻、电感、开关时间、冷却方式等）。；研究对象：用于塞曼减速器的Bitter型电磁铁线圈，具体设计用于减速锂原子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该Bitter型电磁铁线圈可在不破坏真空系统的前提下轻松拆卸、重新配置、修理和更换，且能使用单一直流电源产生近乎理想的磁场分布，性能优于其他设计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该Bitter型电磁铁线圈可在不破坏真空系统的前提下轻松拆卸、重新配置、修理和更换，且能使用单一直流电源产生近乎理想的磁场分布，性能优于其他设计。；创新点：该线圈设计可反复拆卸、修改和重新组装而不损失性能，且能改装到现有超高真空（UHV）腔体上，提供了比传统电磁铁设计更大的灵活性。摘要未突出说明与传统Bitter型线圈在具体结构或材料上的差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验设计与测试：采用Bitter型电磁铁线圈结构，测量了电阻（5.7(9) mΩ）、电感（8.8(2) μH）和开关时间（低至~100 μs），并采用强制风冷进行散热。

papers.title: Ultrafast Third-Harmonic Spectral Modulation and Self-Action in Resonant Nonlocal Metasurfaces
papers.abstract: Quasi-bound states in the continuum enable exceptional field confinement, strongly reducing the pump intensity threshold for nonlinear light-matter interaction in dielectric metasurfaces. As a result, nonlinear self-action effects, often elusive in bulk nonlinear media, emerge at moderate excitation intensities. Here, we show how pulse duration and resonant coupling govern the nonlinear self-action mechanism in resonantly enhanced third-harmonic (TH) generation from a nonlocal metasurface. We identify two excitation regimes that interact differently with the resonant mode, revealing complementary intensity-dependent responses. Under spectrally narrow picosecond excitation, resonance-enhanced TH generation shows pronounced deviations from cubic scaling at high intensities. In contrast, broadband femtosecond excitation transiently drives the resonance, encoding the nonlinear response in the spectral reshaping and broadening of the TH signal. Simulations reproduce both regimes: continuous-wave modeling captures picosecond power scaling and higher-harmonic interactions, while time-domain simulations resolve femtosecond dynamics. These results clarify nonlinear self-action in metasurfaces featuring quasi-bound states in the continuum, linking strong field confinement to conversion efficiency, scaling behavior, and distinct spectral dynamics under different excitation conditions. This work sheds light on the interplay between pulse duration, bandwidth, and resonant coupling in high-Q nonlocal dielectric metasurfaces, advancing their use in ultrafast and nonlinear nanophotonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要提及“Simulations reproduce both regimes: continuous-wave modeling... while time-domain simulations...”，同时描述了实验现象（如TH信号的光谱重塑与展宽）。；研究对象：非局域介质超表面中基于准连续态束缚态（quasi-BICs）增强的三次谐波（TH）产生，以及脉冲宽度和共振耦合调控的非线性自作用效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在共振增强的非局域超表面中，皮秒和飞秒两种激发机制与共振模式相互作用方式不同，导致互补的强度依赖响应：窄带皮秒激发下三次谐波偏离立方标度律，宽带飞秒激发则通过光谱重塑与展宽编码非线性响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在共振增强的非局域超表面中，皮秒和飞秒两种激发机制与共振模式相互作用方式不同，导致互补的强度依赖响应：窄带皮秒激发下三次谐波偏离立方标度律，宽带飞秒激发则通过光谱重塑与展宽编码非线性响应。；创新点：揭示了高Q非局域介质超表面中脉冲持续时间、带宽与共振耦合对非线性自作用机制的协同调控，将强场局域与转换效率、标度行为及不同激发条件下的光谱动力学联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用不同脉冲宽度（皮秒与飞秒）激发非局域超表面，测量三次谐波信号；理论上分别使用连续波模型（模拟皮秒功率标度与高次谐波相互作用）和时域模拟（解析飞秒动力学）。

papers.title: Quench Spectroscopy of Magnetic Excitations on a Superconducting Quantum Processor
papers.abstract: The elementary excitation spectrum of a many-body quantum system encodes many key properties, including phenomena as diverse as transport, thermalisation and ground state structure. Excitation spectra of strongly correlated systems are typically encoded in dynamical structure factors, which are demanding to measure experimentally and challenging to compute classically. Here we use quench spectroscopy on a superconducting quantum processor to extract excitation spectra of spin chains of $L=101$ spins. By tailoring the combination of quench protocol and observable, we selectively access distinct excitation sectors across several phases of the spin-$1/2$ XXZ chain, resolving free magnons, multi-magnon bound states, and two-spinon continua. Notably, we demonstrate that the protocol does not rely on ground state preparation: in the classically challenging gapless regime, we extract spectra directly from the quench dynamics of easily prepared product states, a procedure that is natural and straightforward on quantum hardware. Our work establishes quench spectroscopy as a fast and flexible probe of many-body excitation spectra on digital quantum hardware, introduces a novel quench protocol that does not require costly state preparation routines, and provides a scalable route towards regimes where classical simulation may become intractable.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：superconducting quantum processor、quench spectroscopy、quantum hardware。；研究对象：自旋-1/2 XXZ链中的磁激发谱，包括自由磁子、多磁子束缚态和双自旋子连续谱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超导量子处理器上通过淬火光谱学成功提取了101个自旋的XXZ链的激发谱，并证明该协议无需基态制备，可直接从易于制备的乘积态的淬火动力学中提取谱信息。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超导量子处理器上通过淬火光谱学成功提取了101个自旋的XXZ链的激发谱，并证明该协议无需基态制备，可直接从易于制备的乘积态的淬火动力学中提取谱信息。；创新点：提出了一种无需昂贵基态制备的淬火协议，可直接从简单乘积态的淬火动力学中提取多体激发谱，为在经典模拟可能变得棘手的区域提供可扩展的途径。
papers.method_zh: 使用超导量子处理器进行数字量子模拟，采用淬火光谱学（quench spectroscopy）协议，通过定制淬火方案和可观测量，选择性地访问不同激发扇区。

papers.title: Time-Dependent Integrability from Gauge Theory, I
papers.abstract: Solvable time-dependent systems provide important settings for studying non-equilibrium physics, where exact results are rare. They are also useful for benchmarking quantum simulations, which can directly probe real-time dynamics beyond the reach of conventional numerical approaches. In this paper, we show that the four-dimensional Chern-Simons theory offers a natural and unifying framework for constructing such systems. Focusing on classically integrable field theories, we consider a generalization of the four-dimensional Chern-Simons theory in which the usual holomorphic one-form is replaced by a more general, spacetime-dependent one-form.
